tool.name: nf-core md5sum
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ find -L * -maxdepth 0 -type f \\ ! -name '*.md5' \\ -exec sh -c 'md5sum ${args} "\$1" > "\$1.md5"' _ "{}" \\;
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": md5sum: \$( md5sum --version | sed '1!d; s/.* //' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Create MD5 (128-bit) checksums
